Informações da Vaga

Descrição

Responde pelo acompanhamento das medidas que visam proteger a integridade física e a capacidade de trabalho dos funcionários e terceiros da Unidade onde atua na Kothe, em cumprimento às legislações e normas pertinentes e procedimentos definidos pela Empresa. Controlar e atualizar os documentos de PPRA, PCMAT, PGR, PCMSO, PPR, PAE, PCA, LTCAT e AET da Unidade onde atua, visando atender requisitos legais e orientando gestores nas tomadas de decisões diárias a respeito de segurança e medicina do trabalho.

Dar suporte à Empresa quanto ao atendimento das normas regulamentadoras e demais legislações aplicáveis, viabilizando tecnicamente o atendimento a todos os pré-requisitos necessários ao efetivo cumprimento legal. Responder pelo controle de fichas e formulários de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente - SSMA, visando o atendimento a requisitos legais e procedimentos internos da empresa.

Realizar estudos e análises dos riscos físicos, químicos, biológicos, mecânicos, ergonômicos e de acidentes, existentes nos locais de trabalho, indicando medidas de controle de acordo com o cargo e função exercida e propondo medidas de proteção e prevenção. Controlar e atualizar os indicadores de SSMA, estruturando ações a partir de estatísticas para tomada de decisões operacionais e gerenciais.

Realizar a gestão dos custos de SSMA, através planilhas eletrônicas e análise para apresentação aos gestores para conhecimento e tomada de decisão. Dar suporte técnico ao gestor, na elaboração e atualização dos procedimentos operacionais, visando identificar e detalhar as atividades, mapeando riscos e medidas de controle existentes a fim de garantir a execução da tarefa com segurança.

Ministrar treinamentos de segurança do trabalho, demonstrando e conscientizando os colaboradores sobre condições de trabalho perigosas, medidas preventivas de segurança e de atuação adequada ao tipo de operação executada. Identificar, através de visitas a campo, condições de trabalho e comportamentos inseguros, agindo preventivamente para evitar qualquer tipo de dano pessoal, material e/ou ambiental.

Notificar os colaboradores e liderança sobre atos ou condições inseguras, indicando as ações necessárias para corrigi-las, inclusive orientando sobre a política de consequências da empresa e as medidas disciplinares cabíveis. Registrar as ocorrências de acidentes/incidentes envolvendo pessoas, máquinas e/ou equipamentos.

Prestar suporte técnico na investigação de ocorrências de acidentes/incidentes envolvendo pessoas, máquinas e/ou equipamentos, apoiando na estruturação das ações para evitar as reincidências destas ocorrências. Providenciar atendimento ambulatorial ao acidentado, encaminhando para atendimento hospitalar, após avaliação do profissional de saúde.

Participar nos programas e campanhas de educação sanitária, preparando e distribuindo material de divulgação, e auxiliando na orientação dos colaboradores quanto à aquisição de hábitos de saúde e prevenção de doenças. Controlar os atestados de saúde ocupacional da unidade, identificando vencimentos, encaminhando colaboradores para exames de regularização, em atendimento a legislação vigente.

Participar de reuniões com o cliente com objetivo de repassar informações pertinentes de SSMA, obtendo apoio para a execução de ações. Participar de auditorias do cliente e do corporativo com objetivo de identificar a conformidade do processo SSMA.

Efetuar a gestão de compra, armazenamento e distribuição de materiais de segurança para toda a unidade. Efetuar a gestão de contratos de prestação de serviços da unidade relacionados à segurança, desde a contratação, fiscalização e medição no sistema.

Responder pela qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho dos recursos, serviços e informações geradas pelas tarefas sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo o sigilo sobre assuntos relacionados às atividades da empresa. Conhecer, aplicar, promover, cumprir, fazer cumprir e sugerir normas e condutas voltadas para a segurança no trabalho e preservação ambiental, contribuindo para a eliminação de situações que possam representar riscos de acidentes no trabalho e degradação do meio ambiente.

Apoiar o gestor em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindo problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de procedimentos e ações a serem adotadas. Elaborar e acompanhar o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança), participando da escolha dos temas e auxiliando na preparação de material.

description:
Applications must be submitted in English

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work, a champion of diversity, and a model of social responsibility. We’re currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have maintained a top-four spot for the last 13 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire exceptional people and create an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. We’ve been recognized by Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor, and the Human Rights Campaign for our commitment to diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ, and parents.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join our Product Management & Innovation experts within the AI, Insights & Solutions team. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

As the PM & Innovation Lead, you will play a critical role in identifying, developing, and launching physical and digital products, services, or experiences that deliver measurable business and user value. This position requires deep expertise in Design Thinking (plan and execute insight-driven discovery, ideate innovative solutions, and craft compelling value propositions) and desirable digital product management capabilities. You’ll work cross-functionally with business stakeholders, consultants, designers, engineers, and customers to spark new ideas and turn them into reality.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design Thinking & Innovation (Mandatory):

  • Lead and facilitate discovery, ethnographic research, customer insights gathering, and journey mapping to uncover unmet user needs.
  • Synthesize insights into clear opportunity areas and customer-centric problem statements, creating powerful storytelling.
  • Develop and test value propositions using qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Plan and facilitate ideation sessions, applying a range of brainstorming and creative problem-solving techniques.
  • Develop benchmarking and future trends analysis; synthesize findings and create compelling communication.
  • Rapidly develop and iterate MVP concepts, prototypes, and proofs-of-concept for validation.
  • Assess solutions for desirability, feasibility, and viability, and guide product recommendation and development.
  • Manage cross-functional workstreams, enabling collaboration between design, data science, engineering, and consulting teams.
  • Build internal capabilities, capture learnings, and scale team best practices.
  • Lead end-to-end digital innovation project delivery: from discovery and ideation to product launch.
  • Translate insights and validated concepts into actionable product visions, epics, roadmaps, and user story backlogs.
  • Prioritize features and enhancements based on user and business value, technical dependencies, and resource constraints.
  • Manage and groom product backlogs, ensuring clarity and alignment with strategic goals.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and data teams through agile processes—define acceptance criteria, manage sprints, and drive delivery.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:

  • Act as a champion for user-centric and innovative thinking within the organization.
  • Engage, influence, and align stakeholders at all levels, from senior executives to operational teams.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and roadmaps clearly and persuasively in workshops and meetings. Generate powerful storytelling.

ABOUT YOU

Must-haves:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Design or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6+ years of experience delivering innovation in consulting, tech, industries or startups.
  • Proficiency in Design Thinking methodologies, tools, and frameworks (e.g., interviews, synthesis, journey mapping, ideation, prototyping).
  • Proficiency in planning and running qualitative and quantitative user research, and skilled in synthesizing insights and translating into product opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies; experience writing epics, user stories, and managing digital product roadmaps.
  • Knowledge and use of GenAI tools; previous experience in Gen AI cases is a plus.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of managing interdisciplinary teams and diverse stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong analytical and execution skills.

The Opportunity: As a Lead Software Engineer (Front End) at Agoda, you will drive the technological evolution of our front-end systems. This position requires a deep understanding of front-end development principles, a passion for crafting exceptional user experiences, and expertise in various front-end technologies.

  • Leading in building a culture that optimizes applications using best practices for performance.
  • Maintaining coding standards and staying up-to-date to industry and technology development.
  • Part of strategic discussion relating to Agoda's future technology directions and development practices.
  • Contribute to the professional development of the team.

  • 10+ years of software development experience in building large scale web application, with a minimum of 3 years in a Tech Lead role.
  • Proven experience designing, building, improving, and operating high-performance, scalable front-end systems.
  • Extensive experience with client-side technologies & modern frameworks (e.g., Javascript, Typescript, React).
  • Eager to work in multiple programming languages and frameworks, constantly striving to raise technical excellence.
  • Experience mentoring and growing Senior and Staff engineers through thorough and convincing communication.
  • Provides technical direction within and across groups by leading projects and building systems with company-wide impact.
  • Strong understanding of the business and how their systems impact the bottom line; able to redirect the team based on business priorities.
  • Constantly read and learn, moving Agoda forward technically, influencing other teams, and proactively improving others.

It’s great if you have:

  • Knowledge of physical architecture at scale, building resilience and highly available solutions.
  • Strong experience in all aspects of client-side performance optimization.
  • Proficiency in modern coding and design practices. For example, Clean Code, SOLID principals, and TDD.
  • Knowledge of back-end technologies and how they integrate with front-end systems.

description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Aspen Technology, Inc. is a global leader in process control, design and optimization software. Our Advanced Process Control (APC) software controls more than half of all plants around the world that use APC technology. We constantly drive innovation in our products to remain the industry leading engineering technology company for the process industries.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Support Engineer to join our industry leading APC team. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of chemical engineering principles and be able to learn new concepts quickly. The candidate should be an innovative thinker, demonstrate high initiative, have great communication skills and work to the highest ethical standards.

Aspen Technology, Inc. offers a thorough training program to develop our technology leaders of tomorrow. Through classroom training, mentored hands-on work with varied Process Control projects and real-world customer problem solving, engineers can quickly gain rich industry experience.

Aspen Technology, Inc. is looking for the right candidate to fill this important position. This is a long-term career with opportunity for growth and development in a cutting-edge engineering technology company.

Your Impact

  • Assignments will be varied. Your time will be divided between solving customer technical problems with our APC software via telephone/web, implementing APC projects, delivering high quality training on our APC product line, and other department projects as needed.
  • Drive improvement in our APC software. Provide your own ideas and bring customer feedback to the R&D team to make our products better.
  • Serve as a technical expert and provide technical leadership in several specialized areas within our APC technical support team.
  • Develop and maintain APC training course materials and curriculum to include newly released functionality and the latest trends in Process Control implementation methodology.
  • Author white paper solution articles for publication to the user community through our support web knowledge base.
  • Travel to customer sites if required. Travel is usually less than 25% and may occasionally be international.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s or Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or related discipline
  • 2-5 years of experience with Advanced Process Control in an industrial environment. University level projects may count towards some of the experience.
  • Hands-on problem solving skills with a drive to deliver quality work
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and customer relationship skills
  • Be able to work well in diverse teams composed of people with varied backgrounds
  • Demonstrated ability to convey complex information in a clear and concise manner in English and Portuguese
  • Spanish proficiency is a plus

O Grupo Vivart, em Cuiabá, está lançando um programa Trainee Comercial inovador, desenvolvido sob medida para identificar e formar novos talentos na área comercial do mercado imobiliário .

Se você busca uma carreira dinâmica, com potencial de crescimento e a oportunidade de fazer parte de algo grandioso, esta é a sua chance!

Nosso programa intensivo de três meses oferece uma imersão completa no universo das vendas imobiliárias.

Seja parte da revolução no MERCADO IMOBILIÁRIO.

Objetivos Gerais do Programa Trainee:

  1. Qualificar Leads: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de marketing para entender os leads gerados e qualificá-los com base em critérios específicos que indicam seu potencial de compra.
  2. Prospectar Potenciais Clientes: Usar técnicas de prospecção, como pesquisas de mercado e utilização de redes sociais, para identificar e abordar novos potenciais clientes.

title: Investment Operations Associate
description:
Description

Join Our Dynamic Team and Elevate Your Career!

Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Apply for our exciting role and enjoy a range of benefits that will help you grow both professionally and personally:

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with colleagues from all levels and different teams within the organization, fostering a collaborative environment and learning from diverse perspectives.
  • Global Exposure: Gain international experience by coordinating investment documentation for institutional pension client portfolios in the US and Canada, and understand different market dynamics.
  • Impactful Work: Take on significant responsibilities such as reviewing and executing formal agreements, directly impacting the investment activities of institutional pension clients.
  • Project Management: Utilize your strong project management skills to organize, plan, and execute projects efficiently.
  • Communication Skills: Effectively communicate with fund managers, custodians, and other external parties, as well as internal teams.
  • Legal and Financial Expertise: Dive into the financial contracts and legal terminology, perfect for those with a keen interest in the legal and financial aspects of investment operations.
  • Autonomy and Teamwork: Enjoy the balance of working independently as a self-starter while also being a team player who fits seamlessly into the wider practice.

This position will be responsible to perform legal reviews and manages the signatures (executions) of the necessary documentation for the implementation or on-boarding of Investment Managers (these are investment management companies (funds and other assets authorized to be used for pensions under ERISA)) that will be part of our investment portfolios in one way or another for our clients in the USA and CAN.

The Investment Operations Associate will coordinate legal and investment review activities to assist the Implementation Team with its portfolio activities.

As a member of the Management Onboarding Team (within the larger Operations Team), you will initiate efficient processes for reviewing and implementing agreements on behalf of our institutional pension clients. The role requires the ability to collaborate on cross-functional teams with colleagues from all levels, while effectively communicating opinions and ideas in a succinct and coherent manner.

The Role

  • Incorporate key details in the preparation of agreements, and related documentation pertaining to investing the assets of retirement plans with investment managers.
  • Review client documents (including plan documents, trust agreements, investment policies) as it relates to the AML (anti-money laundering)/KYC (know your customer) process.
  • Effectively communicate with fund managers, custodians, and other external parties involved to ensure all agree on a trade timeline.
  • Learn about the wider investment consulting business by gaining exposure to numerous facets of the industry and have opportunities to work with multiple different teams within the organization.
  • Develop collaborative relationships and openly communicate on work matters with internal teams.
  • Effectively interact with internal teams to keep them informed on progress and ensure they carry out any required actions.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • At least five years in an investment operations environment
  • Undergraduate degree
  • Project management skills, attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines are critical
  • Ability to be a self-starter and work independently, but also cooperatively in a team environment
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills in English is a must
  • Understanding of financial contracts and legal terminology
  • Understanding of investment fund structure
  • Team-player with the ability to fit seamlessly into the wider practice
  • Microsoft office advanced (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, mainly)
  • Ability to liaise with third-party organizations (Investment Managers and Custodians/Banks) and with all levels of staff within the practice
  • Experience in making agreements, reviewing and/or legal documentary in Fiduciary or Trust Fund environment with Pension Fund.

Equal Opportunity Employer

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. title: Senior Business Analyst - Digital BSS
description:
If digital transformation , next generation technology and growth opportunities excite you, then apply to join our Netcracker Technology Team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams , earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world.

What is in it for you?

At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.

What is the scope of this role?

Netcracker Technology is looking to hire a Business Analyst to join our Implementation Engineering teams located throughout the LATAM region. As a CRM/BSS Domain technological subject matter expert (SME), you will be responsible for leading a team providing cost-effective solutions to business and technical challenges faced in large/complex Telecommunications projects. Business Analysts are working as a company’s representatives in front of the enterprise customer. You will be responsible for defining and documenting measurable criteria for solution assessment, proposing solutions, and bringing best practices. It is expected that you will have recognition in the Telecommunications industry as a CRM or BSS Domain SME.

What will be your responsibilities?

  • The key element of the role is focused on analysis and project design, which can be delivered through the baseline capabilities of existing products. Most importantly - stakeholder management as well as expectation management.
  • Collecting and collating business requirements for Business-to-Business telecom products on various network technologies.
  • Guiding and coaching the business stakeholders through the requirements gathering process.
  • Providing clarification and acting as a point of reference for business requirement inquiries by solution design and project delivery teams.
  • Working with project teams to agree on an approach and keep them informed of progress.
  • Facilitating workshops required to understand and document detailed requirements and solution behavior.
  • Working closely with the delivery team to ensure functional and non-functional completeness of the solution.
  • Creating comprehensive and unambiguous documentation that outlines the requirements of stakeholders, traceable for the testing team and understandable for the development team. Developing comprehensive knowledge of the aligned business area and the trust of its business stakeholders.

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • Minimum 7+ years of sufficient technical knowledge to understand high-level architecture and technical requirements around BSS/CRM solutions for Telecom projects.
  • Experience with next-gen CRM and Converged Billing applications (CPQ, Order Management, Product Catalog, etc) .
  • Strong business analysis background, preferably in an internet/software development company.
  • Organizational skills, able to work simultaneously on a number of assignments when required.
  • Knowledge of business analysis principles and methodologies.
  • Proven ability to work BSS/CRM functionally to drive the accurate capture of requirements, resolving and closing down issues and information shortfall as they appear.
  • Experience of working within Waterfall & Agile methodology.
  • Ability to collaborate and solve challenges.
  • Proven experience of successfully working within transformation projects, or projects with B2B products.
  • Previous experience leading architecture teams.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese languages.
  • Availability to work from the office in a Hybrid mode (at least 3 times per week).

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

Who is Netcracker Technology?
We are a forward-looking software company, offering mission-critical solutions to service providers around the globe. Our comprehensive portfolio of software solutions and professional services enables large-scale digital transformations, unlocking the opportunities of the cloud, analytics, virtualization, and 5G mobile networks. With an unbroken service delivery track record of more than 25 years, our unique combination of technology, people, and expertise helps companies transform their networks and enable better experiences for their customers.

title: Senior HRIS Workday Analyst
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior HRIS Analyst to our People team in Brazil ! This person will provide continued optimization and support of Workday’s HCM, Benefits, Absence Management and Time Tracking Modules along with other systems used by managers and employees worldwide to achieve business goals. You will provide support for employees and partner closely with the People, IT, and Finance teams.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Build and support the configurations for the following Workday modules: HCM (Reporting/Security), Absence Management, Benefits, and Time Tracking;
  • Partner with and support our business partners within the People team as well as stakeholders from the IT and Finance team on all Workday requests;
  • Continuously assess and evaluate business processes, recommending efficiencies and automation, as well as provide enhancements and configurations through the use of technology to achieve operational excellence;
  • Monitor the HRIS Support Desk and ensure tickets are being routed, customers are promptly responded to and issues resolved in a timely manner;
  • Effectively communicate and respond to general HRIS inquiries, providing customer service to associates, managers, payroll processors, and HR Business Partners;
  • Create and sustain data management procedures and audits to maintain data integrity and accuracy. Also build and maintain data catalog to ensure understanding of data delivered;
  • Develop user procedures, guidelines and documentation and train users on new processes/functionality;
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and ensure file delivery and follow up on data issues with external integration consultant;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have an excellent understanding of the Workday’s HRIS information structure, functions, and processes;
  • Solid experience in configuration and administration experience on the Workday platform. Experience in configuring Workday HCM, Absence Management, Benefits, and Time Tracking is a strong plus;
  • Familiar and comfortable with using Workday EIB's and building complex Workday reports and Calculated Fields;
  • Strong Excel skills including VLookups and Pivot Tables;
  • You are highly organized with the ability to support multiple priorities in a dynamic environment;
  • You have a demonstrable ability to build sound relationships and clearly communicate expectations;
  • Excellent investigation and troubleshooting skills and can work independently and thrive as part of a team;
  • Able to communicate with Fluency in English.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Workday and Advanced-Fluent English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

description:
Direct message the job poster from Grupo Disbyte

About our Company

GRUPO DISBYTE is much more than a company; we're a powerhouse of creative minds and professionals, united by our shared love and passion for creating unique quality products and solutions from the ground up. Our purpose is straightforward yet very challenging: to democratize access to high quality products leveraging technological innovation.

Our origins trace back to the online marketplace where our entrepreneurial journey began. This foundation not only shaped our approach but also enabled us to incubate and launch a diverse range of products and services.

Today, these products stand as a testament to our commitment, sold exclusively within the marketplace. We take pride in our deep-rooted integration - from ideation to production. By collaborating closely with factories, we can present our offerings under our distinct brands, fostering a direct and authentic connection with our supporters and ensuring quality is always there.

As 2025 unfolds, we're on a quest to grow further, expanding our horizons, connecting with more people, and continuing to make a meaningful impact.

If you resonate with our journey and our aspirations, then you just might be the person we're looking for.

We are looking for highly motivated, curious, experienced, and talented individuals who can think outside the box to achieve company objectives regarding value and partnerships with our suppliers. Our organization moves quickly, and you must too.

Key Challenges & Responsibilities for this Role:

  • Product Supply: Ensure timely, quality, and cost-effective supply across different product lines.
  • Supplier Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations with suppliers leveraging market insights, engineering specifications, complex datasets, pricing tools, and macroeconomic variables to achieve a highly efficient contract in terms of cost, quality, payment terms, and delivery terms.
  • Negotiation Foundation: Utilize insights gained from engineering analyses as a foundation for negotiating with suppliers, ensuring data-driven decisions that enhance cost efficiency while maintaining product standards.
  • Ensure health of supply base by evaluating and selecting suppliers based on capability, quality, reliability, and price competitiveness.
  • Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with departments such as Product Engineering, Sales & Marketing, and internal teams to coordinate purchasing needs, new projects, and ensure efficient product flow, always taking into consideration compliance standards.
  • Cost Optimization Strategy: Collaborate closely with our engineering team to develop strategies for optimizing product costs without compromising quality or functionality.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and efficient communication with all stakeholders, setting expectations, providing updates, and following up to ensure alignment and progress.
  • Strategic Business Trips: Travel frequently to China to strengthen relationships with our local team, fostering trust and collaboration, and negotiate directly with key suppliers, ensuring the best deals for the company.
  • Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and enhance purchasing processes and vendor relationships to drive operational efficiency and cost savings.
  • Agile Mindset: Pursue constant improvement on purchase contracts and conditions based on an always-evolving market, aiming for increased revenue and profitability directly impacting the value created for both our company and customers.
  • Market Analysis: Continuously monitor the market, conducting research to stay updated on industry trends, pricing shifts, and competitor activities. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to refine procurement strategies and improve product offerings.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Technical Expertise: General understanding of engineering principles, quality standards, commercial regulations, and foreign trade laws.
  • Data Analysis: Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and interpretation, enabling informed decision-making.
  • Project Management: Proven project management abilities, with experience in managing multiple projects, meeting deadlines, and achieving objectives within specified timeframes.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with suppliers and internal teams, ensuring clear and efficient information exchange.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, with a strong focus on results and continuous improvement.
  • Languages: Proficiency in spoken and written English.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office products - Excel, Power BI, Oracle.
  • At least 5 years in a similar position.

Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

About Eightx

We provide Fractional CFO and Bookkeeping services for fast-growing eCommerce Brands and Agencies from Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom with one goal in mind: to help eCommerce business owners scale their businesses with more cash and less stress.

Lastly, as you might expect of a finance company, we work really hard when we need to, but we don't work hard just for the sake of it. We don't miss our kids' concerts, we work out during the day, and we usually sign off early on Fridays.

About The Position

You're an elite and experienced accountant and bookkeeper passionate about having a real impact on people's lives. The work you do helps people truly unplug on vacation, have more time with their kids, and enjoy running their businesses.

You will assist a portfolio of clients worldwide with closing their month-end financials, categorizing expenses, reconciling bank accounts, and understanding their financials. You will close client books within two to ten business days from month-end, accurately and efficiently. You will work with various tech/software platforms including Netsuite, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, Xero, Hubdoc, Dext, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Glew.io, Amazon Seller/Vendor, Rippling, Gusto, and more.

What you will do

Time Zone

You will need to work from 10 am-6 pm EST (with adjustments for client or team meetings).

Month End Close

Close client books within two to ten business days after month-end. Maintain proper working papers for fixed assets, loans, prepaids, and other accrual accounts. Make assumptions and estimates when necessary, and post accruals to cover expected expenses.

Bookkeeping

Perform weekly bookkeeping for clients, using rules to auto-categorize transactions. Attach receipts using Hubdoc or Dext. Adjust charts of accounts as needed. Handle payroll for Canadian or US clients and manage all bookkeeping needs.

Compliance

Ensure clients stay up-to-date with regulatory filings such as sales tax, payroll, and corporate filings.

Reporting

Prepare weekly flash reports for clients.

  • Solid understanding of US or Canadian GAAP
  • Self-motivated with good judgment and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills

Your experience and education

  • CPA or CA designation (Argentina, US, Canada, England, etc.)

  • What are your strengths?
  • Where do you see yourself in five years?

Make the video no longer than three minutes. Applications without a video will be ignored.

title: Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais Iheus
description:
O auxiliar de limpeza desempenha um papel fundamental na manutenção da higiene e organização de diferentes tipos de ambientes. Suas responsabilidades incluem a limpeza de pisos, móveis, banheiros e outras áreas, utilizando produtos de limpeza adequados. Eles são responsáveis por garantir que o ambiente esteja limpo e seguro para os usuários.

Além das tarefas de limpeza, pode ser encarregado de manter o estoque de materiais de limpeza organizado, reportar necessidades de manutenção, como reparos necessários, e colaborar com outros profissionais para manter o ambiente em boas condições.

Por lidarem diretamente com a limpeza e manutenção dos espaços, desempenha um papel crucial na saúde e bem-estar das pessoas que frequentam esses locais, garantindo um ambiente agradável e seguro para todos.

O auxiliar de limpeza trabalha seguindo um conjunto de tarefas essenciais para manter a limpeza e organização de diferentes ambientes. Eles começam o dia organizando seu material de trabalho e recebendo as instruções sobre as áreas que precisam ser limpas.

Primeiramente, o auxiliar de limpeza realiza a remoção do lixo, recolhendo e descartando os resíduos de acordo com as normas estabelecidas. Em seguida, eles procedem à limpeza dos pisos, utilizando vassouras ou aspiradores de pó, dependendo do tipo de superfície.

A limpeza dos móveis, mesas, e outras superfícies é feita com panos e produtos de limpeza específicos para cada tipo de material. As janelas também são limpas para garantir que o ambiente esteja bem iluminado e agradável.

Os banheiros são uma área crítica e exigem uma atenção especial, onde são utilizados desinfetantes e produtos específicos para garantir a higienização completa do ambiente.

Alinhado à nossa cultura, nosso objetivo é tornar a Astra um lugar cada vez mais inclusivo. Aqui, em nosso programa, incentivamos a contratação de mulheres, pessoas negras, pessoas com deficiência e suas diversas interseccionalidades. Venha ser único com a gente, venha ser um ESTAGIASTRO!

ATENÇÃO, ESTUDANTES!

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas de materiais para construção do Brasil? Então dê o primeiro passo para construir uma carreira brilhante.

A Astra é uma companhia em constante evolução, com grandes desafios e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal. Nascemos como uma pequena marcenaria, em 1957, no interior de São Paulo, e hoje somos uma empresa multiespecializada que atua no segmento de materiais para construção, com itens que vão da fundação da obra ao acabamento, do item técnico ao de decoração.

No Brasil, fomos pioneiros na criação dos assentos sanitários de plástico e nos tornamos líderes de mercado nesta linha de produtos. Sistemas de descarga, acessórios para banheiro e construção, materiais hidráulicos e itens para acessibilidade são outras linhas que integram nosso portfólio de produtos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Criar e manter conteúdo estratégico de interface (microtextos, mensagens de erro, botões, instruções, tooltips, onboarding etc.) focado em clareza, empatia e usabilidade.

  • Apoiar a construção e evolução do Design System, assegurando consistência de voz, tom e estilo em todos os canais.
  • Redigir conteúdos para interfaces integradas com APIs, sistemas legados e serviços backend, considerando as restrições e possibilidades da arquitetura digital.
  • Criar e manter guias de estilo, glossários e boas práticas de escrita para produtos.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Experiência sólida como UX Writer, Content Designer ou Redator(a) de Produto Digital.
  • Experiencia em projetos B2B\B2C , com Magento serão considerados um diferencial .
  • Excelente domínio da língua portuguesa (fluência gramatical, semântica e estilística).
  • Capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos e complexos em linguagem acessível, clara e útil para o usuário final.
  • Experiência com Design System, componentização textual e adaptação de conteúdo para múltiplos contextos e plataformas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de design (Figma, Miro) e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Noções de usabilidade, arquitetura da informação e acessibilidade textual.
  • Conhecimento básico sobre tecnologias frontend (ex: React, micro frontends) para se comunicar de forma eficiente com desenvolvedores.
